title: If AI coding is lowering your code quality, you're not managing quality right
summary: This article challenges the common narrative that AI coding tools are degrading code quality, arguing instead that the root cause lies in inadequate quality management practices. The author contends that when teams properly implement quality gates, code reviews, and testing standards, AI-assisted coding can coexist with high-quality output. The piece serves as both a rebuttal to AI-skepticism and a practical guide for organizations struggling to maintain standards in the AI coding era.
problem_solved: Addresses the misconception that AI coding tools inherently reduce code quality, reframing the issue as a failure of quality management processes.
why_valuable: Provides a balanced perspective that helps teams embrace AI tools while maintaining or improving code quality through proper engineering discipline.
